In every number-based lottery game, there\'s a certain order in which winning numbers are drawn. The "rank" in this app reflects your personal alignment with that order. It is calculated based on the distance of your selected planet from Earth at the exact date and time of the draw. This cosmic relationship can subtly influence which number combinations are most in sync with you.
